name: examples
description: Concrete examples illustrating the concept, requirement, or type definition.

aiGuidance.purpose: A short, concrete illustration attached to a record. Non-normative: an example shows the rule working, it never adds to the rule.
aiGuidance.extraction: Use this field only for illustration that fits in a sentence or two — a canonical name, a representative value, a one-line scenario: "for example, `com.semanticops.srs/meta.section@1`". Anything larger — a JSON snippet, a worked walkthrough, anything wanting a fenced code block — belongs in its own `com.semanticops.spec/example` record, which exists for exactly this and renders as its own element. Relate it to this record. Be concrete: real names and real values, never foo/bar placeholders.
aiGuidance.negativeGuidance: No fenced code blocks and no headings here — that content is an `example` record. No RFC 2119 keywords: an example that introduces a requirement the normative text does not state is a specification bug. Do not use an example to cover a case the normative text has not defined.
